_note: Node 2b defense-line 2 (boundary gate) spec. model_module points to gravity_assist_model.py (on PYTHONPATH from the task dir). run_model returns a dict. primary_result = best_moon_probe_delta_v_km_s (the headline single-flyby deceleration bound).

cases.name: baseline_realistic_params
cases._doc: Sanity: with realistic Galilean-moon params the bound must be a finite, positive number (Io has the largest v_moon = sqrt(G/a) because its orbit is the smallest -> fastest).

cases.name: zero_gravity_no_momentum_reservoir
cases._doc: G_J -> 0: v_moon = sqrt(G_J/a) -> 0 (the moon's orbital speed IS the momentum reservoir). The deceleration bound must go to 0. Expect |value| <= TOL.

cases.name: probe_mass_independence_check
cases._doc: M_moon appears only in the ~m/M elastic correction (negligible). Varying M_moon by 1e6 must NOT change the bound (which depends on G_J and a only). Expect |value| unchanged, i.e. bounded by the realistic bound magnitude plus TOL.

sweep._doc: Monotonicity: as v_infinity INCREASES, the required deceleration (v_capture - v_infinity) DECREASES, so the best-moon assist covers a LARGER fraction -> frac_covered_by_assist monotonically INCREASES. The sweep overrides each moon's v_infinity via the sweep value and tests the frac_covered_by_assist key.
